estatePlan.concept: A flat-land Caribbean sanctuary organized as a luminous contemporary cloister: a protected arrival house frames a long water garden and pool court, while detached guest and wellness pavilions occupy quiet palm-garden clearings.
estatePlan.character: The estate pairs pale limestone, warm timber screens, bronze-framed glass and deep floating roof planes. Its plan creates a calm sequence from a ceremonial northern arrival court through a private shaded courtyard to a resort-scale southern pool garden, with separate guest and wellness retreats.
